Project summary

Siddh Sai Corporation has executed waterproofing works in multiple cities across four states: Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. Waterproofing is where poor workmanship shows fastest, usually in the first monsoon, so a multi-state record is built only by work that holds.
